## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one coherent purpose.
- [ ] Installer behavior changes include tests.
- [ ] `VERSION`, `package.json`, and `SKILL.md` versions agree.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] No credentials, generated dependencies, or local installation files are included.
